name: What should homeowners prepare before planning an accessibility remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before planning an accessibility remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting work, measure the dimensions of any current mobility equipment, such as wheelchairs, walkers, or shower chairs, and list specific daily challenges. Take note of whether doors need clear swing clearance and identify where the user naturally reaches for support. Sharing these details during an on-site walkthrough with Abraham Becerra ensures framing adjustments, grab bar heights, and shower fixture placements match the user's specific reach, body mechanics, and future mobility needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure mobility devices, pinpoint daily movement bottlenecks, and note specific reach heights so framing, doors, and grab bars can be tailored directly to the resident.
